name: Smartcat
tagline: Smartcat is a translation and localisation platform that combines AI translation with a marketplace of professional translators. Its AI engine provides instant machine translation, while the built-in editor lets human translators review and refine output. Enterprises use it for large-scale, high-quality multilingual content.
